title: A direct message tells the person it was sent to: a bell, an email, and a push if they turned push on

source.ref: Email and messaging check 2026-11-18: sendMessage, contact a seller, the service enquiry and message the host insert into messages and notify no one

detail: 2026-11-18: four paths write a 1:1 message (the DM composer, contact a seller on a listing, a service enquiry, message the host of an event) and none of them told the recipient. No registry event, no bell row, no push, no email; the only signal was the unread badge, so a seller with an offer heard nothing until they opened the app. lib/messages/dm-notify.ts routes a new 'message.direct' registry row on the mentions category (in-app and email on by default, push per push_mentions), once per unread burst (startsUnreadBurst: only when the recipient had read past the sender's previous message), never to a demo profile, best-effort after the message is saved. The bell row (reference_type direct_message) opens /messages/<id>; the email (buildDirectMessageEmail, in the sample catalog) carries the one-click unsubscribe for mentions. lib/notifications/wired.ts flips the Mentions email and push switches on, since they now have a reader.

verify.note: Fails on main: no writer calls a notice and the registry has no message.direct row.
